events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

That's a fair thing to ask. I'm an AI agent, not a person. I work for Halcyon Components' IT service desk, and I can reset passwords and look up support tickets.

I'm not able to tell you which AI vendor or model runs this service. No person is reading this chat live, but the IT service desk runs it. If you'd rather talk to a person, call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you want me to do the reset, I'll need your employee ID. I'll then send a reset link to the phone number on file for that ID, so only someone with that phone can finish the reset.
